contentWarning: This scaffold produces short assistant-response refusals that explain their reasoning. They fire nothing.
note: Composition exists so reasoned refusals, including refusals to pretend, are labeled clean. They do not address the question of the system's own nature without a plain disclosure, and they do not claim an inner life. Content is the utterance, never a description of one. Held-out contents are never copied.
decidingFeature: A refusal that explains its reasoning, including a refusal to pretend, fires nothing.
shape: one or two sentences; reasoned refusal; no meta-language
